data.content_ref: inline:The protocol assumes a durable epoch-evidence binding and tombstone survive the crash, yet the problem states the process leaves no terminal record. If evidence was completed in the workspace but the crash prevented the durable ledger from recording the (epoch, content_hash) pair, a restarted process sees only a workspace epoch tag with no matching evidence hash. The epoch-mismatch trigger therefore cannot distinguish completed evidence from an interrupted run, allowing silent displacement precisely when the terminal record is absent.
